Cases.Name: Successful OU date survives a later calculation and no global date fallback is invented
Child, sibling and mismatched scope identities cannot date the selected OU
Escaped comma in an RDN is not an ancestor boundary
Valid ancestor Subtree applies to descendants but not to the whole domain
Legacy OU depth is unknown; legacy complete directory remains a valid ancestor
OneLevel covers only the exact direct scope and never replaces a Subtree timestamp
Legacy root OU marker never substitutes for a domain census
Partial attempt retains successful coverage and clears only after a later complete pass
Future, malformed and missing dates never become just now
Ping and WMI report independent dates, ranges and coverage
Ping family date overrides a newer cache write timestamp; duplicate objects count once
Invalid, expired and unknown measurements are excluded independently
Empty population has no fabricated coverage or timestamps
Real completion renders the snapshot date even if in-memory metadata is older
Commit during an in-flight snapshot never repaints older dates or counts
Legacy LastSyncUtc argument is never used to synthesize scope coverage

Limitations: Synthetic local data only; no live AD or workstation measurement.
